widen.à samedi: to Saturday (À samedi ! = see you Saturday)
widen.à lundi: to Monday (À lundi ! = see you Monday)
widen.à mardi: to Tuesday (À mardi ! = see you Tuesday)
widen.à mercredi: to Wednesday (À mercredi ! = see you Wednesday)
widen.à jeudi: to Thursday (À jeudi ! = see you Thursday)
widen.à vendredi: to Friday (À vendredi ! = see you Friday)
widen.à dimanche: to Sunday (À dimanche ! = see you Sunday)
widen.à demain: to tomorrow (À demain ! = see you tomorrow)
widen.fait: does / makes / done, made / comes to (weather: il fait froid = it's cold)
widen.il y a: there is / there are (il y a dix minutes = ten minutes ago)
widen.il n'y a: there is / there are (il n'y a pas = there isn't; il n'y a plus de = there's no more)
widen.tu me dis: you tell me, you say to me / let me know (tu)
widen.passé: past / passed (est passé = came by, dropped by)
widen.en: in, by / some, of it, of them (pronoun)
widen.toujours: still / always (il est toujours en retard = it's always late)
widen.heures: o'clock / hours (deux heures de bus = two hours on the bus)
widen.plaît: pleases (le pantalon vous plaît ? = do you like the trousers?)
widen.nom: name (au nom de = in the name of)
widen.la bise: cheek kiss (greeting) (faire la bise = to greet with a kiss)
widen.me faire: make me / do … for me (me faire un devis = give me a quote)
widen.trompé: got it wrong (said by a man) (se tromper de … = to take the wrong …)
widen.trompée: got it wrong (feminine) (se tromper de … = to take the wrong …)
widen.trompés: got it wrong (plural) (se tromper de … = to take the wrong …)
widen.je me suis trompée: I got it wrong, went the wrong way (said by a woman) (se tromper de … = to take the wrong …)

add.on est: we are (on est allés = we went)
add.on a: we have (on a mangé = we ate)
add.on fait: we do, we make / we're doing
add.on dit: we say, people say (on dit tu = we use tu)
add.on se dit: we say to each other (on se dit tu = we use tu with each other)
add.on se fait la bise: shall we do the cheek kiss? (faire la bise = to greet with a kiss)
add.qu'il y a: that there is / that there are
add.il en reste: there's … left / there are … left (of them)
add.ça ne va pas: aren't you well? / it's not OK
add.marche plus: doesn't work any more (informal, ne dropped)
add.toutes les: every (toutes les dix minutes = every ten minutes)
add.besoin d'un: need a (avoir besoin de = to need)
add.je vous prends: shall I get you / I'll get you (vous)
add.je te prends: shall I get you / I'll get you (tu)
add.vous avez mal: you're in pain, does it hurt? (vous avez mal à = your … hurts)
add.tu as mal: you're in pain, does it hurt? (tu as mal à = your … hurts)
add.c'est pour moi: it's for me / it's on me (I'm paying)
add.il est comment: what's it like? / what's he like?
add.tu as fait comment: how did you manage? / what did you do? (tu)

rewrite.why: « Non, plus » segments as the key « non plus » (= either / neither) across the comma; the free-standing « ! » blocks that span so the filled line reads « non · plus tard » = no · later.
